title: Miami Gardens Community Cleanup Day
desc: Join neighbors for a morning cleanup on 40th Avenue. Gloves and bags provided.
body: Starting at 7:00 AM. Families and beginners welcome. Refreshments provided afterward.

title: Dunedin Beach Cleanup with Salty Soul
desc: Coastal cleanup at Dunedin Causeway. All ages welcome.
body: Meet at 8:00 AM. Bring water, sunscreen, and closed-toe shoes. Bags and gloves provided.

title: Walnut Creek Community Cleanup
desc: The Cleanup Crew hosts a litter cleanup in Walnut Creek and Alamo.
body: Volunteer event. Meetup details posted by The Cleanup Crew. Bags and sanitizer provided.

title: Recycle Better July 2026
desc: Workshop on improving recycling habits and reducing household waste.
body: Hosted by Sustain Dane. Thursday evening session. Registration required.

title: Genesee County Recycle Day
desc: Household waste and recycling drop-off event for residents.
body: Appointment required. Register through GCMPC. Typical hours 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM.

title: DuPage Clean-Up, Green-Up Day
desc: Annual park cleanup and landscaping event at Westlake Park.
body: Help with park cleanup and landscaping. Bring gloves and enthusiasm. Supports 8th annual event.

title: San Bernardino Community Cleanup
desc: Earth Day community cleanup at two San Bernardino locations.
location: Muscoy Elementary School, San Bernardino, CA
body: 7:00 AM - 1:00 PM. Two convenient locations. Bring reusable water bottle and wear closed-toe shoes.

title: HRRP Boston Post Cleanup
desc: Hudson River waterfront cleanup in honor of National Water Quality Month.
body: Volunteer cleanup event. Details available on site.

title: Huntington Beach Cleanup with Veterans
desc: Open community cleanup on Huntington Beach with veteran volunteers.
location: 405 Pacific Coast Hwy, Huntington Beach, CA 92648
body: Doors open 6:45 AM, cleanup 9:00-11:30 AM. Families and dogs welcome.

title: Tire Recycling Event (South Gate Park)
desc: Drop off old tires at South Gate Park. Family-friendly, 6-hour event.
body: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM. Event staff checks load limits per vehicle.

title: NoHaz Household Hazardous Waste Collection
desc: Safe disposal for household hazardous waste in Oakland County.
body: Saturday 8:00 AM - 1:00 PM. Registration opens July 11.

title: FREE Bokashi Composting Workshop
body: Hosted by Pennsylvania Resources Council. Free admission.
